title: Multi-Path Routing in Decentralized Exchange Networks: Convex Allocation and an Improving-Path Certificate
summary: We present a graph-theoretic and convex optimization framework for multi-path routing in decentralized exchange networks, together with its implementation and empirical evaluation on Ethereum mainnet. The framework models the market as a directed token multigraph whose arcs carry AMM exchange functions.
